observations.description: The measurement value for common address 2, IOA 1007, changed from approximately 102.1 in frame 10 to approximately 150.4 in frame 11, followed by a small increase to 151.0 in frame 12. This is a temporal anomaly in the supplied series, not evidence of an attack or confirmed data manipulation.
possible_explanations: A genuine rapid change in the underlying process or measured quantity
A sensor, scaling, calibration, or acquisition transient
A control-system state change occurring between frames 10 and 11
An IEC104 source-data or communication issue
recommended_checks: Review the source equipment and process trend around the interval represented by frames 10-12
Verify the configured engineering units, scaling, and calibration for IOA 1007
Compare the value with redundant sensors or related measurements
Inspect source-device logs for a state change, restart, acquisition warning, or quality event
observations.title: Abrupt measurement change at frame 11

observations.description: Across the contributing frame range 9-12, the IEC104 receive code remained 1, the transmit code advanced from 2 through 5, and the measurement cause of transmission remained 3. Measurement quality was 0 in every observed frame, with negative and test flags false. These observations provide contextual consistency but do not establish that the measurement values are correct.
possible_explanations: Normal sequential IEC104 reporting from the source endpoint
A valid process change carried by otherwise well-formed protocol messages
A source-side data problem not represented by the observed quality and test fields
Monitoring or decoder limitations that do not expose relevant device diagnostics
recommended_checks: Confirm the endpoint roles and IEC104 configuration for stream_4
Validate device-side quality/status diagnostics beyond the decoded quality field
Check for corresponding IEC104 events, commands, or status changes outside frames 9-12
Review a longer time window to determine whether the frame-11 transition is isolated or recurring

result.summary: IEC104 measurements for IOA 1007 increased gradually in frames 9-10, then showed a sharp one-interval rise at frame 11 before remaining nearly stable at frame 12. The protocol counters and quality-related fields otherwise appear consistent across the observed range.
